entities.name: Query conotoxin precursor
observations: The 90-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein A0A125S9F2 from Conus imperialis (100% identity and full-length coverage).
Annotated as a probable neurotoxin and secreted extracellular protein.
Annotated precursor organization: signal peptide residues 1–18, propeptide residues 19–29, mature conotoxin chain residues 30–89.
Predicted molecular mass is 10,536 Da for the unmodified precursor; theoretical pI is 8.88.
The mature region is cysteine-rich and is expected to form three disulfide bonds based on the matched reference annotation.
The reference annotation includes C-terminal glutamic acid amidation at precursor position 89; processing and modification should be considered when interpreting mature peptide mass.

entities.name: A0A125S9F2
observations: Reviewed UniProt entry for Conus imperialis conotoxin Im6.2.
Function: probable neurotoxin; localization: secreted; GO cellular component: extracellular region.
Reference features specify signal peptide 1–18, propeptide 19–29, mature chain 30–89, three disulfide bonds, and a modified C-terminal residue.

entities.name: Q9BPC7
observations: Reviewed Conus ventricosus conotoxin VnMEKL-023 is a lower-identity homolog (36.5% identity, 94.4% query coverage).

Annotated as secreted extracellular peptide with ion channel inhibitor activity, supporting a conotoxin-like pharmacological role for the sequence family but not proving the exact target of the query peptide.
